attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using functions and parameters in your projects to code things to happen more easily.

questions.hint: What needs to happen in order for a function’s code to run?
questions.title: [Select one] When does a function’s code run?

answers.text: Over and over for as long as the program is running.
Only after it has properly stretched and warmed up.

questions.correctResponse: Functions let us run and re-run code when we tell it so in the program.

questions.hint: Which of these things can be used to change how a program runs?
questions.title: [Select one] A _______ is a piece of information that changes how a program runs.
questions.correctResponse: These are adjustable values in your code. It can be a number, character, sprite, etc.

questions.hint: What do parameters do in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] Parameters make it easier to customize code by allowing coders to slightly change values to meet their needs.
questions.correctResponse: You can use parameters to tweak your program and achieve the result you  want!

questions.hint: How many times can you call a function’s code to run in a project?
questions.title: [Select one] A function can be used ______.
questions.correctResponse: Functions let us control when chunks of code are repeated.

questions.hint: Is a function for code that happens once or code that happens a lot?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of the following are examples of using functions in your day-to-day life?

answers.text: A once in a lifetime task, you won’t repeat

questions.correctResponse: Functions are useful for repeated acts that can be performed whenever needed.

subgroups.title: Functions and Parameters!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using functions and parameters in your projects to code things to happen more easily.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of White Belt! Before you create your final White Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! In this level, you’ll learn about functions, which are chunks of code that run whenever they are called. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Function Junction
badges.description: Use functions to make something happen at different points in a project.

badges.title: A Whole New Kind of Sprite
Making a Connection
badges.description: Make something happen when 2 different sprites overlap.

badges.title: Right Behind You
badges.description: Set one sprite to follow another sprite.

badges.title: Make It Dazzle
badges.description: Add an effect to any sprite.

badges.title: The End of the Road
badges.description: End the game in a win or loss when something happens in a project.
